claimType: exploratory representation study on already-exposed U5a rooms and target views; not confirmatory efficacy evidence
motivation: U5a enlarged Gaussian covariance with calibrated predictive sigma and lost to depth-only covariance in all five exposed rooms. U5c showed the dominant mechanism: larger covariance added substantial target-view coverage, but most newly covered pixels were foreground-wrong and many depth-only-correct pixels became candidate-wrong. U6a therefore keeps the exact depth-only covariance and every primitive, and moves the frozen calibrated uncertainty signal into Gaussian opacity so uncertainty can reduce frontmost visibility without enlarging spatial support.

inputs.sourceViews: reuse the exact eight U5a/U3b source observations per scene
inputs.targetViews: reuse the exact eight U5a held-out FARO target views per scene
inputs.targetManifests: reuse exact U5a targets.json files without modification
inputs.baselineRenders: reuse exact frozen U5a depth-only-covariance renders and their SHA256 values; do not rerender baseline
inputs.renderer: reuse the exact authorized maveb-gaussian-depth binary SHA256 from U5a

representation.name: uncertainty-modulated Gaussian visibility with bounded covariance
representation.centers: identical to U5a depth-only-covariance Gaussian centers
representation.covariance: identical to U5a depth-only-covariance log-scales and rotations for every primitive; calibrated sigma must not change covariance
representation.primitiveCount: identical to U5a depth-only-covariance and preserved exactly for every method

opacityMapping.shuffledOpacity: opacity=0.99*w_rel using the exact frozen shuffled confidence

rendererMechanism.depthDefinition: first front-to-back Gaussian whose local alpha survives the cutoff
rendererMechanism.intendedEffect: lower uncertainty-derived opacity shrinks effective visibility support through the existing alpha cutoff while preserving geometric covariance and primitive centers

frozenPredictiveModel.note: The opacity ratio sigma0^2/sigma^2 cancels depth under the frozen multiplicative U1b model; no new depth-dependent mapping is introduced.

assetIntegrity.candidateAndShuffledNonOpacityColumns: must match the U5a depth-only-covariance PLY row-for-row and value-for-value after parsing numeric ASCII fields

renderPlan.calculation: 5 scenes * 2 new opacity methods * 8 frozen target views
renderPlan.targetOrder: 0 through 7 from each immutable U5a targets.json

evaluation.primary: same U5a scene metric: arithmetic mean across eight targets of fraction of all FARO-valid pixels rendered within 0.05m
evaluation.intervalConvention: nearest-index p2.5/p97.5 with half ties lower, descriptive only

mechanismReadout.promising: candidate improves held-out within-5cm correctness relative to fixed-opacity depth-only in multiple rooms and is directionally better than shuffled, without catastrophic coverage loss
mechanismReadout.opacityOverPruning: candidate substantially lowers coverage and does not recover within-5cm correctness; do not make opacity more aggressive on these rooms
mechanismReadout.associationNotCausal: candidate and shuffled move together; do not attribute change to calibrated confidence placement
mechanismReadout.visibilityMechanismUseful: candidate reduces the U5c foreground-occlusion failure while preserving enough coverage to improve the primary metric; only then consider a separately frozen untouched U6b confirmation

claimBoundary: U6a is exploratory because all room identities and target views were exposed by U5a/U5c. A positive U6a mechanism cannot establish efficacy. No opacity exponent, floor, clipping, or alternative mapping may be tuned on these five rooms after outcomes are seen.
